pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding to positions (no scaling/averaging down) when an existing order in the same direction is floating negative.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero entries permitted within 5 minutes of high-impact macroeconomic print windows, requiring a confirmed 1-minute structural market shift (CHOCH) plus a minimum 1.5 ATR buffer for stop placement.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stop activation or partial scale-out once floating profit hits $15.00 to prevent gains from evaporating.
